case.title: Apple FY2024 evidence-constrained review
case.question: 截至 2024-11-01，Apple FY2024 的增长结构、现金创造与主要反向风险发生了什么变化？

evidence.excerpt: Q4 FY2024 revenue was $94.9 billion, up 6%; GAAP diluted EPS was $0.97 and the adjusted figure excluding the State Aid charge was $1.64.

evidence.locator: Part II, Item 8, Consolidated Statements of Operations, pp. 28-29
evidence.excerpt: FY2024 total net sales were $391.035 billion versus $383.285 billion in FY2023; net income was $93.736 billion and diluted EPS was $6.08.

evidence.locator: Part II, Item 7, Products and Services Performance, p. 23
evidence.excerpt: FY2024 Services net sales were $96.169 billion, up 13%, primarily reflecting advertising, App Store and cloud services.

evidence.locator: Part II, Item 7, Gross Margin, p. 23
evidence.excerpt: FY2024 gross margin percentages were 73.9% for Services, 37.2% for Products and 46.2% in total, compared with 70.8%, 36.5% and 44.1% in FY2023.

evidence.locator: Part II, Item 7, Products and Services Performance, p. 23
evidence.excerpt: FY2024 iPhone net sales were $201.183 billion versus $200.583 billion in FY2023, which Apple described as relatively flat.

evidence.locator: Part II, Item 7, Segment Operating Performance, pp. 21-22
evidence.excerpt: Greater China FY2024 net sales were $66.952 billion, down 8%, primarily from lower iPhone and iPad sales; renminbi weakness also had an unfavorable effect.

evidence.locator: Part II, Item 7, Provision for Income Taxes, p. 24
evidence.excerpt: FY2024 included an approximately $10.2 billion one-time net income tax charge related to the State Aid Decision, contributing to a 24.1% effective tax rate.

evidence.locator: Part II, Item 8, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, pp. 32-33
evidence.excerpt: Cash generated by operating activities was $118.254 billion in FY2024 versus $110.543 billion in FY2023.

evidence.locator: Part II, Item 8, financing activities, p. 33; Note 11
evidence.excerpt: FY2024 cash used to repurchase common stock was $94.949 billion; the company also reported repurchasing about 499 million shares.

evidence.locator: Part II, Item 7, Liquidity and Capital Resources, p. 24
evidence.excerpt: At FY2024 year-end, unrestricted cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled $140.8 billion; fixed-rate notes principal was $97.3 billion and commercial paper was $10.0 billion.

evidence.locator: Part I, Item 3, Digital Markets Act Investigations, p. 17
evidence.excerpt: The European Commission opened three DMA investigations in 2024; a final violation could require conduct changes and fines up to 10% of worldwide annual net sales.

evidence.locator: Part I, Item 1A, international disputes and business interruptions, p. 5
evidence.excerpt: Substantially all manufacturing is performed in whole or in part by outsourcing partners located primarily across mainland China, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam.

evidence.locator: Part II, Item 7, Manufacturing Purchase Obligations, p. 25
evidence.excerpt: Manufacturing purchase obligations were $53.0 billion at FY2024 year-end, of which $52.9 billion was payable within 12 months.

evidence.locator: Part I, Item 1A, Legal and Regulatory Compliance Risks, pp. 12-13
evidence.excerpt: Changes in antitrust, digital platform, privacy and AI laws may increase costs, limit feature availability, or require changes to products, business practices or supply chains.

evidence.locator: Part II, Item 7, Products and Services Performance, pp. 21-22
evidence.excerpt: FY2023 Services net sales were $85.2 billion, up 9%; this historical result is superseded by FY2024 evidence for current-period growth analysis.

claims.statement: 截至 FY2023，Apple Services 年度收入增速为 9%。
claims.invalidationConditions: 新年度或季度正式文件披露更新的 Services 收入增速。

links.rationale: FY2023 10-K 直接给出 9% 的历史增速。
若旧 Claim 被误读为当前增速，FY2024 的 13% 已更新期间口径。

claims.statement: FY2024 总收入同比增长约 2%，但 iPhone 全年基本持平且 Greater China 收入下降 8%，增长并非来自所有核心区域和硬件品类同步扩张。
claims.invalidationConditions: FY2024 报表被重述，或后续期间 iPhone 与 Greater China 同时恢复持续同比增长。

links.rationale: 全年总收入同比增加约 2%。
iPhone 全年收入基本持平。
Greater China 收入下降 8%。
Q4 单季增长强于全年，但不能外推下一年度。

claims.statement: FY2024 Services 的收入增长与更高毛利率改善了收入和毛利组合；DMA 调查与数字平台监管则可能削弱这种经济性。
claims.invalidationConditions: Services 毛利率接近 Products 水平、Services 收入下滑，或监管措施实质压低相关费率和收入。

links.rationale: Services 收入增长 13%。
Services 毛利率显著高于 Products 并同比提升。
DMA 调查可能要求业务改变并带来重大罚款。
数字平台等法律变化可能改变产品和商业模式。

claims.statement: FY2024 经营现金流高于当年股票回购现金支出，但 Apple 同时仍有较大固定利率票据和商业票据余额。
claims.invalidationConditions: 经营现金流持续低于资本回报现金支出、流动性明显下降，或债务再融资能力恶化。

links.rationale: 给出经营现金流规模。
给出股票回购现金支出。
保留现金与证券、票据和商业票据余额，避免误写为无杠杆。

claims.statement: FY2024 GAAP 净利润和 EPS 同比比较受到约 102 亿美元 State Aid 一次性所得税费用的显著影响，Q4 调整后 EPS 与 GAAP 口径不可混用。
claims.invalidationConditions: Apple 或 SEC 后续重述该费用的金额、性质或会计处理。

links.rationale: 提供 GAAP 全年净利润和稀释 EPS。
提供一次性税务费用和有效税率变化。
提供官方 Q4 调整后 EPS 对账口径。

claims.statement: Apple 制造高度依赖亚洲多地外包伙伴，且一年内到期的制造采购义务接近 529 亿美元，贸易限制或供应中断构成成本和执行风险。
claims.invalidationConditions: Apple 正式披露制造来源已显著分散、关键单一来源风险大幅下降，且短期采购义务明显降低。

links.rationale: 提供外包制造地点和贸易限制风险。
量化短期制造采购承诺，不代表中断概率。

claims.statement: 截至 2024-11-01，欧盟 DMA 调查和数字平台监管是 Apple Services 增长与利润率持续性的关键反向监测变量。
claims.invalidationConditions: DMA 调查终结且无重大整改或罚款，或后续证据表明相关变更不影响 Services 收入与利润率。

links.rationale: 提供具体调查、潜在救济和罚款上限。
提供监管变化可能改变业务实践的风险。
Services 当前增长良好，是需要监测的暴露面。
Services 当前毛利率较高，说明暴露的重要性但不证明未来损失。

Part II, Item 7, Products and Services Performance, pp. 21-22

preStaleReview.reason: The filing directly supports FY2024 cash flow, repurchases and debt balances; approval does not imply future coverage.

workflow.staleReason: FY2024 Form 10-K supersedes the prior-period growth rate for current-period analysis.

revision.reason: Replace the stale prior-period growth statement with the FY2024 comparison while preserving the old source as context.

input.statement: Apple Services 收入从 FY2023 的 852 亿美元增至 FY2024 的 961.69 亿美元，FY2024 同比增速 13%，高于 FY2023 的 9%。
input.invalidationConditions: 后续正式文件重述 FY2024 Services 收入，或下一期间显示 Services 收入同比下降。

links.rationale: FY2024 10-K 提供当前期间收入额和 13% 增速。
stale 的 FY2023 来源只保留为对比基线。
补充 Services 的利润结构，不证明收入增长本身。

finalReviews.reason: Approval is limited to reported FY2024 growth and the FY2023 comparison; it does not extrapolate 13% into future periods.
The 10-K directly supports total revenue growth, flat iPhone revenue and the Greater China decline.
The observed mix improvement is supported, but the contested combined claim is too broad to approve as one conclusion.
The 10-K supports the one-time tax charge and GAAP results; the adjusted Q4 metric remains explicitly contextual.
Approval records disclosed outsourcing concentration and commitments as risk exposure, not as a probability of disruption.
Approval treats regulation as a monitoring variable based on disclosed investigations and risks, not as an incurred loss.
